entities.name: Dragon Nations
entities.description: Dragons of all five colors united to fight the Phyrexians during the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Primeval Dragons
entities.description: Ancient dragons woken by sacrifice, who turned on Dominaria's defenders.

events.summary: The Dragon Nations' leaders sacrificed themselves to wake the Primeval Dragons, who took control and turned on Dominaria's defenders.
events.quote: the leaders of the Dragon Nations sacrificed themselves

events.summary: The reborn Darigaaz sacrificed himself again, the Primevals were defeated and the Dragon Nations were freed and dissolved.
events.quote: After the reborn Darigaaz again sacrificed himself and the rest of the Primevals were defeated

relations.quote: Darigaaz was the leader of the red flight
